name: Cisco Meraki - Flows Overview
description: The Cisco Meraki - Flows Overview dashboard provides insights into  traffic sources, destinations, protocols, and traffic action time comparisons. The panels also show detailed information on the top source IPs, destination ports, and possible port scan attacks for both allowed and denied traffic.
title: Cisco Meraki - Flows Overview

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Metricsdatasource}}  firewall (deny or "Group Policy Deny" or 1) (6 or tcp)
|	parse regex " (?<name>\S*?)\s(?<msg_type>urls|firewall|events|ids-alerts|security_event|airmarshal_events?)\s+" nodrop
| kv regex "=(.*?)(?:\s|$)" "src", "dst", "mac", "protocol", "sport", "dport", "type" as src_ip, dest_ip, mac_address, protocol, src_port, dest_port, type  nodrop
| parse "pattern: *" as pattern nodrop
|	parse regex " firewall\s(?<action>allow|deny?)(?:\s+|$)" nodrop
| if (action="" and (pattern="Group Policy Allow" or pattern matches "0 *" or pattern matches "allow *"), "allow", if (action="" and (pattern="Group Policy Deny" or pattern matches "1 *" or pattern matches "deny *" ), "deny", action)) as action
| where msg_type="firewall" and action = "deny" and (protocol="6" or protocol="tcp")
| where if ("{{protocol}}" = "*", true, protocol matches "{{protocol}}") AND if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{msg_type}}" = "*", true, msg_type matches "{{msg_type}}") AND if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{dest_port}}" = "*", true, dest_port matches "{{dest_port}}") AND if ("{{src_port}}" = "*", true, src_port matches "{{src_port}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{mac_address}}" = "*", true, mac_address matches "{{mac_address}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}") AND if ("{{pattern}}" = "*", true, pattern matches "{{pattern}}")
| count as eventCount by dest_port 
| top 10 dest_port by eventCount, dest_port asc
